name: Command Palette
description: A ⌘K command palette that opens in a staggered cascade: fuzzy search with highlighter-pen matches, a gliding selection, shortcut hints and combobox ARIA.

props.name: groups
props.type: { id: string; label: string; items: CommandItem[] }[]
props.description: Result groups in order. Items take id, label, keywords, shortcut, hint and a lucide icon.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open once the trigger has landed on first view. ⌘K or Ctrl+K toggles it after that.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the search field on first render. Later opens always focus it.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the chosen item on Enter or click.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: Text on the ⌘K trigger field the palette opens over.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Two queries offered in the empty state.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the selection marker and the highlighter behind matched letters.

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale palette for the trigger, panel and scrim.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root; give it a height (the scrim covers it).
